content:
maya: Found a small unlabelled box in the lobby near the ficus. Says 'Redwood Swag' but no name. Also a walk-in guest (3pm) needs a seat — can someone reserve a chair? cc @frontdesk
frontdesk: Thanks! We put the box in Locker A-3 (photo attached). No shipping label scanned. Guest check-in noted: Naomi L arriving 3pm. We have two temp badges left.
sam: photo pls — curious if it's hoodies :P
maya: uploading pic: `IMG_20240323_1122.jpg` — looks like stickers, small tees, enamel pin.
jordan: If it's tees, size L only? joking. Also I'll snag a folding chair from storage and leave it by the velvet couch.
people-ops: heads up — if nothing on label, keep for 72 hours then donate if unclaimed. Inventory in #ops-log. Also confirm the guest badge flow: frontdesk -> temp badge -> receptionist will escort.
eli: can we hold one pin for the engineering hiring panel later? :raised_hands: 
deliveries-bot: Package received from 'GreenPost Logistics' at 11:12. Tracking: GP-998721. Signature: 'M. Kline'. Photos uploaded.
frontdesk: update — Locker A-3 code is `4421` (set to auto-expire 48h). Naomi L checked in early, seat taken in meeting room B but we offered soft seating.
maya: thanks all. leave the box in locker, I'll catalog contents in #ops-log and ping if anyone claims.
sam: quick q — do we have spare lanyards?
people-ops: yes, spare lanyards in Supply cabinet shelf 2. If you take one, note on the supply tracker.
jordan: also, FYI, someone left a cute postcard on the courier table addressed to 'All Redwoods' — not gonna open? :)
maya: open it. :clap:
